3 The Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) will conduct the procurement process through Competitive Bidding modality, using a non-discretionary “pass/fail” criterion and in accordance with the applicable provisions of Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of Republic Act no. 12009, otherwise known as the New Government Procurement Act. Bids received in excess of the ABC shall be automatically rejected at bid opening. To bid for the aforementioned projects, contractor MUST MANUALLY PURCHASE the bid documents and must meet (but not limited to) the following major criteria in accordance with section 52.4.2 of IRR of R.A. 12009 a. Duly licensed Filipino Citizens or sole proprietorship b. Partnerships duly organized under the laws of the Philippines and of which at least 60% of the interest belongs to citizens of the Philippines c. Corporations duly organized under the laws of the Philippines, and of which at least 60% of the outstanding capital stock belongs to citizens of the Philippines. d. Cooperatives duly organized under the laws of the Philippines e. Persons or entities forming themselves into Joint Venture f. The bidder must have completed a Single Largest Completed Contract (SLCC) that is similar to the procurement be bid & must be at least fifty percent (50%) of the ABC to be bid. g. Computation of Net Financial Contracting Capacity (NFCC) which must be at least equal the ABC to be Bid. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid Security in any of the acceptable forms and in the amount stated under section 56 of IRR of R.A. 12009 a. Cash, or Cashier’s or Manager’s check issued by banks certified by the BSP to issue such financial instrument b. Bank draft or guarantee, or Irrevocable Letter of Credit issued by banks certified by the BSP to issue such financial instrument. c. Surety bond callable upon demand issued by a surety or insurance company duly certified by the Insurance Commission as authorized to issue such security. d. Bid Securing Declaration A complete set of Bidding Documents may be ACQUIRED MANUALLY by interested Bidders from the address given below upon payment of the applicable fee for the Bidding Documents, pursuant to the latest Guidelines issued by the Government Procurement Policy Board (GPPB).
